In this role, you will scope complex projects and deliver simple, elegant solutions by collecting product and business requirements, driving the development schedule from design to release, making appropriate trade-offs to optimize time-to-market, and clearly communicating goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross-functional teams. You will interact with a broad cross-section of the Amazon organization, clarify ambiguous issues, and negotiate effective technical solutions between development and business teams. You will anticipate bottlenecks and escalate issues when required to ensure on-time delivery. This role requires a seasoned individual with excellent experience as a Software Development Engineer and the ability to guide high-level technical design.
  
  
If you are excited about solving complex problems, working across diverse teams, and driving operational excellence at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you!

* Continuously improve existing systems, focusing on test coverage, refactoring, and reducing technical debt.
* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies to solve complex operational challenges.
* Deliver features with agility, contributing to a highly collaborative and innovative team environment.
* Deliver and build software at high bar with respect to quality, security, architecture, scalability and operational excellence.
* Build systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

description:
**Description**
Amazon Time & Pay Innovation (T&PA) organisation is looking for Software Development Engineers who enjoy working in a green field environment building large-scale intelligent products and services that offer a consumer grade user experience using a service oriented architecture, based on native AWS components.
  
  
T&PA mission is to build world-class time systems that are intuitive and friction-free for all users, enable management of time and pay with close to zero defects, are available on-demand as new businesses launch, and flexibly support future business innovation. T&PA serves all Amazon employees across more than 25 countries and a dozen lines of business. We are tackling new, hard problems that Amazon has not solved at scale, creating fundamentally improved ways for employees to record time and reduce pay defects. T&PA has it all - early stage hustle, operational excellence, technical complexity and global scope across multiple Amazon businesses.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for a strong Software Development Engineer who can take the lead in identifying and solving ambiguous problems. You will own and heavily influence the architecture and design, and will write a significant portion of the “critical-path” code. You will solve problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially. You will use highly scalable AWS technologies such as Lambda, EMR, DynamoDB, S3, Kinesis, ECS and many others to do this.
  
  
Successful candidates will be strong leaders who can prioritize well, communicate clearly, and have a consistent track record of delivering large scale solutions. You will contribute to all aspects of an agile software development lifecycle including design, architecture, development, documentation, testing and operations. You will push your design and architecture by owning all aspects of solutions end-to-end, through full stack software development.

Designing, implementing, and testing software solutions using native AWS technologies
  
  
Collaborating with product managers and customers to manage requirements for new features and updates to existing systems

Periodically providing on-call support
  
  
Coaching and mentoring junior engineers on the team
  
  
Working with some of the most talented and dedicated team members you can find
  
  
Having fun

title: Software Engineer (Full Stack) – Clinical Intelligence
description:
Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’ s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
  
  
Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest in the USA and has employees who live across the country. As we expand our global footprint with a new presence in Hyderabad, India, we’re building a world-class team to help us scale this mission and Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation is at the heart of everything we do. This job requires daily onsite work at our office in
**Hyderabad, India.**
**This Opportunity**
Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center (IDC) and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the initial members, you'll help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is a unique opportunity to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub. This highly visible position will report to our Director of Clinical Intelligence and AI Evaluation team directly and will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and ML teams across geographies.
  
  
**Who We Need**
Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex healthcare domain data and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.
  
  
We are seeking
**Full Stack Engineers**
to help build our critical internal annotation and administrative platforms to enable high-quality data modelling, clinical note annotation and normalization, LLM-based labelling, concept mapping, operational workflows and model evaluation frameworks across the company. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex full stack, i.e., both UX and backend data problems and want to build tools used daily by internal clinical domain and technical experts.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain full-stack features for clinical data annotation and internal tooling platforms.
* Implement advanced UI interactions such as text highlighting, tagging, categorization, and review workflows.
* Build backend services that support high-quality data modelling, clinical note annotation and normalization, LLM-based labelling, concept mapping, operational workflows and model evaluation frameworks.
* Collaborate with ML engineers to translate annotation requirements into scalable solutions for LLM based model development and improve model performance.
* Optimize UX performance for high-volume data and concurrent users.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and on-call rotation.
* Communicate on the status of various projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary stakeholders to ensure that clinical data projects are successfully executed and delivered.
* Excel in providing technical analytics support as well as directly working with internal stakeholders to troubleshoot any data analyses. Work with customers to achieve their goals, teaching them how to wrangle and analyze data using SQL, R and Python on real-world data to address their empirical questions.

**Required Skills**

* Graduate or Masters level educational degree in computer science, data science, clinical informatics, health information management, clinical research, data analysis or related fields.
* 2+ years of demonstrated professional software development experience, including,
* Front end development experience with React and TypeScript,
* state management frameworks such as Redux,
* Backend experience using NestJS (Node.js) and/or C#/.NET
* Familiarity with RESTful API design and modern service architectures.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, data structures, at least one statistical programming language (R or Python), familiar with Spark bigdata analytics environments, GenAI tools, for data wrangling, analysis, and reproducible research workflows.
* working with customers or research teams to translate their asks into executable analytical code, rigorous quality analytical datasets, deliver high quality research analyses.
* Strong hands-on problem-solving skills, troubleshoot and identify data or methodological issues early and communicate them effectively. Have ownership, accountability and reliability mindset.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain analytical approaches and findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to learn and adapt quickly in a dynamic start-up environment and a good team-player.
* Willingness to learn new analytical tools, programming languages, and proprietary platforms used to analyze real-world data.

**Preferred Qualifications**
These qualifications are preferred but not required, please do not let them stop you from applying for this role. You will likely get the opportunity to learn how to do these more advanced analyses if you don’t already have experience with them.
  
  

* Spark/PySpark, Databricks, data structures experience
* Experience working with unstructured clinical data or natural language processing outputs
* conducting analyses using large healthcare datasets (e.g., electronic health records, clinical notes or other real-world data sources consisting of millions of patients' data.) optimized to handle large volumes of text, structured and unstructured data and complex review workflows.

**Why Truveta?**
  
  
Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. We are expanding our global footprint. Join us as we build an amazing company together.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage
* Great benefits package
* Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans
* Professional development & training opportunities for continuous learning
* Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
* Generous parental leave
* Regular team activities (virtual and in-person as soon as we are able)

Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude people from some sections, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people. We strongly encourage individuals with these identities to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements.

title: Fullstack Engineer (.NET & React)
description:
TechGrove is the
**Centre of Excellence**
for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About Berkeley Myles
  
We build software for UK manufacturers who can't afford to get things wrong: aerospace, medical
  
devices, oil and gas, motorsport. Our product, ProgressPlus, runs the whole job from first enquiry
  
through to final invoice. Hundreds of manufacturers run on it every day, and when one of them has to
  
prove what went into a part, it's where the answer comes from. We're now building a new product with
  
AI on every stage of that flow.
  
We're part of Banyan Software, the best permanent home for software businesses that serve
  
specialised industries, their employees, and their customers. Banyan is a Great Place to Work Certified
  
company, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top-10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500.
  
Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies
  
across North America, the UK, the EU, and APAC.
  
About the Role
  
ProgressPlus has been running factories since 1999. Every rule inside it is a decision someone once
  
made about how a manufacturer works: when a quote becomes an order, what commits stock, what
  
has to be true before a part can ship. Hundreds of businesses have built their working day on those
  
decisions.
  
We're building the replacement. Feature by feature, that means understanding why each of those rules
  
exists, building what the product manager decides it should become on a cloud platform with AI on
  
every stage, and speaking up when what you find in the old system changes the answer.
  
You'll work across the whole flow: enquiry, quote, order, jobs, scheduling, tracking, quality, shipping,
  
invoice. One month that's purchasing, the next it's shop-floor tracking, and each feature runs from the
  
data model through the .NET service to the part a planner or an inspector uses all day. The features
  
that matter most span several stages, because a change to an order ripples through jobs, stock and
  
invoicing, and the customer expects all of it to agree. That's why every engineer here works across the
  
whole flow.
  
The platform is built and running: five .NET services on Azure with architecture boundaries enforced in
  
CI, a database per customer company, and a Next.js frontend. A platform engineer owns that estate and
  
the path to production. An AI engineer owns the agent layer. You build the product on top of both, and

canvas

once the agent layer exists, you'll be among the first to put AI into the flow. The team you'd join is small:
  
five engineers and a lead.
  
We build with AI coding agents, wired into our issue tracking and version control. The repo already
  
holds what they need: project instructions, coding rules per area, specialised agents for tests,
  
documentation and architecture review, and a learnings log the team maintains. You'll direct the agents,
  
review what they produce, and answer for everything you merge.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
The kind of work on the board: an operator books on and off a job from a tablet on the shop floor and
  
the planner's schedule moves before they refresh. A delivery arrives against a purchase order, gets
  
allocated to the jobs waiting on it, and leaves behind the certificate an aerospace customer will ask for a
  
year later. A quantity changes on a sales order and the works orders, material demand and invoice
  
downstream all agree with it. A stock grid holds every part a customer owns, with filters that compile to
  
SQL and stay fast. And, once the agent layer lands, the first AI on a stage: an agent that drafts a job's
  
audit pack from its real records, with a person approving every page.
  
Building the product
  
Take features end to end across any stage of the flow, from the data model to what the user touches,
  
with tests at each layer
  
Get the cross-stage behaviour right: when an order, a job and an invoice have to agree, make sure
  
they do
  
Get authorisation and validation right on every feature, and never be the reason data crosses
  
between customers
  
Write schema changes as migrations that run safely across every customer's database
  
Keep it fast at real volumes: a customer's full parts list, years of jobs, and a shop floor writing to it all
  
day. Instrument it so we can see when it isn't
  
Prototype when you see a better way. The product manager leads the design and there is no
  
designer in between, so engineers build prototypes against the product's patterns and bring them to
  
the product manager
  
Build the integrations customers depend on: APIs for the systems that read from ProgressPlus,
  
connectors into the ones it reads from, and versioning so neither breaks when we change something
  
Working with agents
  
Direct coding agents on production work: break work into tasks they can execute reliably, supervise
  
them to a merged and tested result, and intervene when their output is wrong. You know which work
  
to hand an agent and which to do yourself
  
Maintain the agent context: project instructions, per-area rules, reusable skills, and the learnings log,
  
so the next person or agent working in that area starts from what you learned
  
The team and the customer
  
Review others' work across the flow with the same rigour as your own, and take review from them
  
the same way

canvas

Take your turn on the application team's support rota: triage what comes in, fix what's yours, and
  
write up anything that should never happen twice
  
Spend time with the people who use the product, customers and our own support team, and turn
  
what you learn into what gets built
  
Support UAT and resolve defects before and after release, and build the features customers need
  
before they can move off the legacy product
  
How We Work
  
Linear as the single board: work traced from issue to acceptance criteria to PR, reporting as a by-
  
product of the work
  
A small team: full stack engineers with a lead, plus AI and platform specialists, on a .NET and Next.js
  
platform on Azure
  
Prototype-led: we design the flow before we build it, against a shared design system
  
AI in daily use across the team: coding agents in the repo with the context they need, and AI tooling
  
for research, prototyping and analysis
  
A customer base we can pick up the phone to, and an implementation team on their sites every week
  
Tech Stack You'll Use
  
Backend: C#, .NET 10, Rebus messaging, SQL Server (database per company), EF Core
  
Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, TanStack Table, Tailwind
  
Testing: xUnit, Vitest and Testing Library, Playwright
  
Cloud: Azure (Container Apps, Azure SQL, Service Bus), GitHub Actions
  
Tooling: Claude Code, Linear, GitHub
  
What We're Looking For
  
5+ years building customer-facing web products across the full stack, and a track record of driving
  
complex, end-to-end features, not incremental improvements, with visible impact on the product
  
Hands-on experience directing agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agents or
  
equivalent) on production code. You can walk us through specific work you shipped this way, how
  
you structured it, and where you had to step in
  
Deep enough in C# / .NET and TypeScript / React to know when the code is wrong, whoever wrote it
  
Solid relational database skills: you can design a schema within an existing model, write a migration
  
you'd run against live data, and find the slow query
  
You treat tests as part of the definition of done, and you can prove a test works by breaking it on
  
purpose
  
Product sensibility: you care about UX, speed and polish, you'd rather ask the person using it for
  
eight hours a day than guess, and you push back when something doesn't feel right

canvas

High ownership: a self-directed, full-lifecycle builder who takes a feature from a conversation with a
  
user to production, and helps shape the problem rather than waiting for a spec
  
Comfortable in a large product you didn't build: you read before you write, you find the existing
  
pattern before inventing one, and you know when to ask for a second opinion
  
You can explain a technical decision and its trade-offs to someone who doesn't write code, and
  
change your mind when they're right
  
Strong written communication: you'll work with a team split across time zones
  
This isn't the role if you want a finished spec before you start, if you'd rather stay on one side of the
  
stack, if you see coding agents as either a threat or a toy, or if a product with twenty-five years of
  
customers behind it sounds like baggage rather than material.
  
Preferred Experience
  
Manufacturing, ERP, MRP or supply chain systems, or genuine curiosity about how factories run
  
Multi-tenant SaaS, especially database-per-tenant
  
Azure services and cloud-hosted applications
  
Building product features on top of an internal agent or tool layer
  
Authoring agent skills, prompt libraries or project instructions that other engineers relied on
  
Accessibility (WCAG) and offline-first or PWA work for the shop floor
  
Replacing a system people already depend on, where "how it works today" is both the spec and the
  
problem
  
What We Offer
  
A team that builds with agents as standard, and a repo that already carries the context they need
  
What you ship goes into factories that can't run without it
  
The backing of Banyan Software, a permanent home for software businesses, with the pace of a
  
small product team
  
Pension, holiday entitlement, remote working and a learning budget
  
A direct line into product and architecture decisions

***Recruitment Notice***

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an
  **@banyansoftware.com**
  email address.
* Remember, employers will
  **never**
  request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message,
  **do not respond**
  — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.
